source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The public invitation attachment caller prevents default link navigation and calls openLinkExternally. The existing helper policy makes its file-scheme permission path independent of the false default preference; that policy is linked to the earlier source lesson. The added test checks the file-URI prefix and waits for an expected permission dialog before canceling it. Its callback Assert.ok(true) marks arrival; it does not assert a native file launch or a security result. Source and fixture identities are checked, but no test, dialog, file or accessibility execution occurred. This finding uses public Git code only.
title: The invitation file-link test separates link routing from dialog arrival
